description.narrative: The Global Seminar, to be held in Copenhagen on 1 -2 October 2019, will be one of the key events for 2019, providing a platform for senior government officials in the law enforcement and security sectors to share and exchange experiences on good strategies, policies and practices to prevent, prohibit and respond to incidents or patterns of torture or other forms of ill-treatment. Up to 32 States will be represented at the Global Seminar, drawn from all regions, to foster a truly cross-regional and global dynamic. A particular focus will be on the challenges and circumstances of Least Developed Countries and Small Island Developing States in implementing the Convention. The Global Seminar will identify and build regional and national opportunities for effective implementation of UNCAT; showcase the latest developments in implementing safeguards against torture and ill-treatment; highlight the role of psychology and neuroscience in law enforcement;and share lessons learned from investigative interviewing as an alternative to confession-orientated interrogation. The event is being hosted by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs as part of the CTI and organised by the CTI Secretariat, in partnership with the Danish Institute Against Torture (DIGNITY).
